title: 第8章 会演才是硬实力
content_zh:
天色已暗。
张远的家不在启明小区，而是在小区外的一条老街上。
小时候，李皓很喜欢去老街玩耍。
不过随着银城发展，老街拆迁了一部分，商贩纷纷离去，老街渐渐荒废了下来，如今已经是人烟罕至，很少有人再来老街这边了。
就连住户，大部分也都搬走了，比启明小区还要死寂。
寂静的街道上，两侧有些老房子还有一些零星的灯火，显得有些诡异。
若是时间允许，李皓应该慢慢等待，每天喝一点泡剑水，慢慢强大自己，再去想其他的事。
可是，时间并不允许李皓这么做。
每拖一天，对李皓而言，危险更大一分。
虽然他可能会更厉害一些，然而，泡剑水也只是让他体力更充沛一些，并不足以让李皓现在有对付红影的力量。
来张远家，李皓就一个目的，他想看看那把石刀还在不在。
石刀若是还在，对李皓而言，也许是个不错的好消息。
若是找不到，那就可能被红影和其背后的势力取走了，这也意味着，李皓的剑，有可能暴露了，甚至有人在打他这把剑的主意。
黑豹无声无息地跟着李皓，黑暗中，黑色的小狗，显得极其不起眼。
轻微的脚步声，在街道上缓缓传荡。
李皓面色如常，前面一间老屋，门上贴着封条，那就是张远的家了。
此刻，他已经可以看到了。
没看到任何人，黑豹也没示警。
不过，李皓也不会将所有希望都寄托在黑豹身上。
当他距离张远家大门不到百米的时候，李皓取出了通讯器，拨通了一个号码。

黑暗中，通讯器散发出淡淡的光芒，照亮了李皓的脸庞。
“嘟嘟嘟……”
片刻后，对面响起了中气十足的人声：“大晚上的，你是不是想通了，在巡检司混不下去了，想回来？”
嗓门很大！
通过通讯器的扩音，在黑暗的街道上传荡。
原本还有些恐惧的李皓，此刻忽然安心了许多，声音带着恭敬，轻声道；“老师，暂时还没那个想法。”
“那你打个屁的通讯！”
通讯的另一方，传来了有些恼怒的声音。
“老师，张远自焚的案子，我这一年一直在追查，我已经查出了一点不同，张远……也许不是意外身亡！”
“嗯？”
黑暗中，李皓面色平静，隐约间却是带着一些狰狞，“我查了一下，这些年银城自焚的不止张远一人，而是好几人，虽然看起来没什么关联，却是隐约有些关系，具体的线索我还没查到。”
那边，忽然安静了下来。
李皓此刻已经走到了张远老屋门前，看着那有些破碎的封条，轻声道：“我现在就在张远老家，我想查查看，有没有别的线索，证明张远是被谋杀，而非意外。”
“李皓！”
通讯那边，传来了老人的沉重喝声：“张远的事，我也知道，按照你的说法，如果是谋杀，那你不要贸然前往，小心发生意外！”
说罢，又大声喝道：“你在那边稍等片刻，我和巡检司还有古院这边打声招呼，你要是需要帮助，马上会有人过来！”
这一刻，对面的袁硕，好像明白了什么。
不需要李皓多说。
当李皓打了这个通讯，告诉他发现了张远不是意外，而是可能死于谋杀，而且本人就在张远老屋那边，袁硕瞬间懂了李皓的意思。
可能有危险！

李皓，此刻需要一些足够震慑的力量，震慑一些暗中可能存在的危机。
不需要袁硕做什么，说什么。
只需要让袁硕知道，他李皓现在人在这，正在追查张远的案子，这就足够了。
一位银城古院的大佬级人物，只要他在关注，那就足够了。
任何人都不敢轻易动弹。
否则，死一个李皓，也许会引出这位古院老人的愤怒，导致更麻烦的事情发生。
外界传闻，李皓和袁硕之前闹翻了。
事实证明，并没有。
在这个夜晚，袁硕的声音，在空寂的街道上传荡的很远，若是真有人一直关注这边，一定可以听到袁硕的话。
古院和巡检司，可能会来人。
就在李皓通话的瞬间，一直不声不响的黑豹，忽然咬了一下李皓的裤腿。
李皓没发现任何异常。
然而，黑豹毕竟比他更敏锐，可能感受到了什么，或者袁硕的话，让一些人暴露了点动静出来，引起了黑豹的关注。
真的有人在盯着这边。
李皓心中微动，这不是坏事，反而是好事，有人盯着，代表张远家的石刀，可能真的没被拿走。
通讯中，袁硕还在继续说着什么。
李皓却是很快笑道：“老师，没那么严重，我给你致电，只是想简单说说这事，关键不是这个，而是我接下了古院外出考察的保护任务，过些天，我可能会保护老师一起外出考察。”
“你？”
那边的袁硕，好像有些意外，很快笑声爽朗道：“也好，那我等你！刚好这次考察任务有些复杂，你跟了我两年，学了不少，却是没有实践过！李皓，这次当成你的实践课如何？你要是表现的好，我可以考虑给你个编外学员的身份，古院的规矩虽然多，可只要你这次考察立功，我照样可以给你毕业！”
“你要知道，能拿到毕业证，你就算还要留在巡检司，一个毕业证，能让你升两级！成为一级巡检，那是板上钉钉的事，比你现在有前途多了！”

李皓露出了笑容，“老师，回头见面了再说吧。我先进屋看看，看看有没有什么线索，等查清楚了张远的案子，抓到了凶手，不用老师说，我也会想办法重回古院。”
“也行！”
袁硕再次叮嘱：“有事随时联系我，没有什么解决不了的麻烦，巡检司和古院解决不了，你老师面子还有几分，真到了必要关头，你小子只要以后给我争口气，我豁出去，有些高人也不是请不来！”
此话一出，李皓心中忽然有些震动和无言的感动。
他知道袁老师的意思。
真到了需要的时候，他所谓的高人，恐怕就是巡夜人了。
以前，李皓从未和老师多说什么。
他担心将麻烦扩大，影响到老师。
可是，以老师的智慧，当听到李皓说，张远的自焚也许不是意外，恐怕也会第一时间想到也许是超能因素干扰。
这才说出了找高人的话。
然而哪怕袁老身份不低，可巡夜人也不是说请就请的，李皓的事不是公事，而是私事，这可能需要付出很大的代价。
“知道了，谢谢老师！”
李皓挂断了通讯，随手撕碎了封条，
当李皓带着黑豹进入了古屋。
寂静的街道外，久久无声。
黑暗中，一双有些幽蓝光芒的眼睛，若隐若现。
夜色下，一道黑色身影仿佛本就是夜的一份子，从上到下，都是黑色，唯独那双幽蓝的眼睛有些渗人，脸上戴着一副厉鬼般的面具，遮掩了相貌，不知男女。
“李皓，张远的同学，死党，银城古院二级学员，去年张远死后退学加入巡检司，一直追查张远自焚事件。今日向巡检司机要室室长王杰汇报，串联六宗自焚案，欲并案处理。”
关于李皓的信息，瞬间在黑影脑海中闪现。
李皓去年退学，加入巡检司，其实已经进入眼线。

何况，好像不止如此，李皓可能还是一位关键人物，只是此事不是黑影管辖范围，暂且不知，只是有人叮嘱，李皓这边，不可轻动，留下有用。
黑影心中想着，的确不可轻动。
刚刚李皓是在和他的老师袁硕通话吗？
袁硕，银城古院顶级元老，古文明探索系主任，和巡夜人有合作，是整个银城少数几位可以和巡夜人直接搭上话的大佬级人物。
“不用别人说，李皓也不能动……”
黑影悄悄靠近了张家古屋，他想知道，李皓进去是为了什么？
张远自焚，死在了古院，家中能有什么线索？
还是为了寻找东西？
至于寻找什么，黑影不知道，但是他的任务就是盯住每一个进入甚至靠近张家老屋的人。
“呜呜！”
低微的鸣叫声从黑豹喉咙中传出，它咬着李皓的裤脚，有些焦躁。
好像在诉说什么。
李皓不动声色，心中却是警惕。
有人靠近吗？
自己和老师的通话，难道还不足以打消一些人的念头？
没有多说，轻轻摸了摸黑豹的脑袋，安抚了一阵，李皓这才看向荒废的张家老宅。
这是一座不大的小院子。
正前方，是主屋。
两侧，一边是张远的次卧，一边是厨房，这地方李皓很熟悉，小时候经常来，哪怕长大了，李皓父母过世之前，家中不大，不适合玩耍，李皓也会经常过来。
这一次，李皓的主要目标是张家的石刀。

他扫了一眼，这古屋看似没人进入，不过一定有人来过，不说其他，有些东西的摆放位置，看起来没什么异常，可对李皓而言，却是清晰地知道，都被动过。
张远家，除了张远，大概就李皓最为熟悉了。
院落中，连那棵老树都被动过手脚，可能曾被人连根挖起，之后再重新栽种回去的。
“石刀若是还在张家，一定不在主屋、次卧，百分百的！”
李皓没少来，自然知道情况，要是在这两处地方，他早就看到了，不会不记得，他没少在张家翻箱倒柜，他那时候把这当自己家，从来不见外。
“我最后一次看到石刀，就是张叔叔打小远那次，我记得张叔随意丢到了地上，就是不知道后来有没有捡起来。”
李皓回想着过去，他隐约记得，张远那时候好像也是不知道从哪个旮旯翻出来的石刀。
张远的父亲，恐怕都不记得自己之前丢哪了，结果被孩子翻了出来，也就借机揍了张远一顿，至于什么祖传物件，恐怕张父都没当回事。
一块破石头罢了！
什么祖传物件？
就算是，也不值钱，要那玩意干嘛，张远不翻出来，张父也许一辈子都不会想起家里还有一块石头传承下来。
沿着记忆中不清晰的方位，李皓慢慢踱步，朝院子角落一处走去。
那里，堆放着一些石头，原本是用来补墙用的。
李皓迅速观察了一下，并没有记忆中那块石头。
他记得，那块石头和刀有些类似。
“暗中有人盯着我，倒是不好大张旗鼓地找。”
正想着，一直没动静的黑豹，忽然低声嘶鸣起来。
“呜呜！”
不是护食的声音，而是带着一些忌惮，黑豹发出了呜咽声。
这时候，李皓也忽然头皮有些发麻！

他顺着黑豹视线，朝主屋方向看去，心中咯噔一跳，这一刻，心脏都跳动的更加剧烈。
主屋的大门，原本是紧闭的，什么都没有。
可这时候，大门好像开启了一道缝隙，而在那缝隙中，隐约可以看到一抹红色。
“血影？”
李皓心脏剧烈跳动起来，血影出来了？
之前他隐约好像也看到过，但是按照他的推断，血影出动，应该在雨夜才对，为何会现在出现，而且就在张家！
“难道……这血影一直在张家待着，寻找石刀，没有离开？”
一抹冷汗，微不可见地从李皓头上渗出。
相遇来的太早！
李皓还没做好万全的准备，此刻在这遭遇血影，一旦对方对自己出手，焚烧自己，那李皓几乎没有任何反抗的余地。
“为什么会出现在这？”
“该死，出现的太早了，我连巡夜人都没见到……”
李皓身体微微有些僵硬，此刻，他身体微不可见地有些颤抖，甚至想要转身逃跑。
可外面，可能也有人在盯着自己。
对，血影一般人是看不到的。
自己不能逃！
否则就算逃了，也会暴露出点什么，比如自己可以看到血影的事实，这也是个巨大的麻烦。
既然看不到，那自己就没道理害怕。
无数念头闪过，下一刻，李皓呵斥一声：“叫什么？安静点！”
呵斥了一句黑豹，李皓看向主屋，喝道：“里面有人？我是巡检司巡检，谁在里面？”

李皓举着旋涡三代，对准了主屋，再次暴喝：“有没有人？出来！”
他明明看到了血影一角，却是强忍着不去看那红色一角，而是一直盯着大门，对着大门方向呵斥。
李皓一步步靠近主屋大门。
陡然，一个箭步，一脚踢出，轰隆一声，主屋的大门直接被李皓一脚踢开。
砰地一声巨响，也引起了附近少数几户人家的注意。
隐约间，传来了一阵悉索声。
李皓没管这些，一脚踢开大门，再次看向黑漆漆的主屋，喝道：“有没有人？我是巡检司巡检，再不出来，我开枪了！”
这一刻，李皓目光盯着前方，额头上却是汗液渗透出来，手臂都在微微颤抖。
他脚下，黑豹早就趴着一动不动了，吓得。
在李皓余光中，在黑豹的狗眼中，这一刻，一道红色血影，其实就站在李皓左侧，血色影子甚至和李皓的脸颊都快贴在了一起。
然而，李皓却是好像没看到一般，完全没有任何反应。
他的视线，一直落在主屋中。
“没人？”
李皓声音有些颤抖，骂骂咧咧的，低声咒骂：“靠！幸好没有其他同事在，不然都被笑死了，大晚上的吓我一跳，我还以为凶手躲在这里呢！”
长长吐了口气，李皓仿佛没看到血影。
抹了抹额头上的汗液，低头看向黑豹，探手就打：“傻狗，没事你乱叫什么，吓死人了！”
黑豹被打了一下，有些无辜，有些恐惧害怕。
你没看到吗？
本狗看到了啊！
它现在头都不敢抬了。

因为那血影，就漂浮在它脑袋上。
而李皓仿佛一无所知，刚刚拍打黑豹，甚至手臂穿过了血影，却是一点感觉都没有，只有一丝丝不可见的阴冷，渗透到了手臂上。
而他却是没有感觉到穿透任何东西的阻滞感。
“无形的存在！”
李皓其实是胆大包天地去试探一下血影，他想看看，是不是真的看不见摸不着，敲打黑豹，就是为了顺理成章地去触碰血影。
结果……真的打不到！
“该死，麻烦大了，这代表枪械一点作用都没了！”
李皓心中惊恐，却是靠着强大的定力，不让自己露出任何异样。
在外人眼中，他应该看不到血影的。
所以刚刚这次敲打，也没有任何问题。
李皓骂了一句黑豹，低声咒骂了起来：“该死的傻狗，再乱叫我剁碎了你！害我踢坏了小远的家门，差点吓的我想打给老师，让他去找巡检司和古院的人了！”
李皓仿佛不解气，又踢了一脚！
这一次，依旧穿透了血影，没有触碰到。
李皓的胆子，不可谓不大。
这血影没有见面就对自己下手，而是好像一直在观察什么，既然如此，此刻他也得装出一副看不到的样子，该如何如何。
再看看黑漆漆的老屋，李皓吐了口气：“大晚上的，还挺渗人的，不行，要不还是打个通讯给老师……巡检司的家伙感觉都不靠谱，一点用没有，小远的案子就是他们结案的，一点异常没发现……实在不行，让老师找那些黑衣人出面就好了。”
黑衣人，也就是巡夜人，李皓曾远远见过一次，当然，没有任何接触。
此刻自言自语，只是为了恫吓罢了。
若是血影有意识，那它该明白自己的黑衣人说的是谁，巡夜人！
李皓也想试探一下，巡夜人和这血影，到底是不是一伙的。

在这危急时刻，李皓反而镇定了下来。
不但没逃，还在不断试探着什么。
逃跑，才是最愚蠢的选择，一旦逃跑，他能看到血影的事情马上暴露，那不死也得死了。
按照李皓的分析，他就算被血影杀，也该是在雨夜，而不是现在，这其中一定有一些原因存在，既然如此，博一次好了！
李皓还在自言自语，好像有些犹豫：“那些黑衣人看起来也很可怕，老师去找，也不知道能不能找来……不管了，巡检司一点线索没有，也许只能靠他们了，我胆子小，本事小，一点办法都没，大晚上来看一看都被吓得半死，恐怕没办法继续查下去了。”
李皓有些沮丧的样子，拿出了通讯器，咬着牙：“只能求助老师了！”
下一刻，李皓开始拨打袁硕的号码。
而就在此刻，李皓心中微微一震，身边的血影，忽然开始震荡起来，院墙外，一股淡淡的红色丝线蔓延而来，连接到了血影身上。
血影好像接受到了什么指令，下一刻，血影迅速飘荡离去，消失在院子中。
不止如此，片刻后，黑豹爬了起来，摇晃了一下尾巴，好像开始活跃了起来。
狗眼看着李皓，带着一些轻松。
“汪汪！”
好像在说，没事了，人走了，那鬼影子也不见了。
李皓脸色却是有些凝重。
血影和院子外面的人，好像是一伙的，这个不重要，他早就有猜测血影不是单独存在的，而是有组织的。
关键在于，院子外的人，好像可以看到血影，甚至可以联系控制血影，让血影离开。
李皓说要找自己老师，找巡夜人，大概让外面的人有些担忧，所以选择了离去。
恫吓的手段起作用了！
可李皓一点开心不起来，那红色蔓延而来的丝线，倒是有些像之前他喝水的时候，看到的那股星光，也就是神秘力量。
“外面的人，是个超能神秘者！”

“对方和血影是合作或者干脆就是控制关系，对方是不是在让血影试探自己？”
“我没办法用枪械杀血影……那……外面如果是人呢？出其不意之下，我杀了那个人，那血影会如何？”
这一刻，李皓忽然感觉自己抓住了什么关键的东西。
血影很可怕，可只要是人……哪怕是超能者，只要是人，就不可能无懈可击。
“血影……神秘人……”
李皓心中呓语一声，不止如此，刚刚触碰到血影的刹那，一直沉寂的玉剑，好像有些蠢蠢欲动，李皓在猜测，难道说，星空剑可以伤害到血影吗？
“这一次，哪怕找不到石刀，我也没白来！”
李皓忽然有些激动起来，也许，我能对付这些家伙，前提是这些家伙不在意自己，否则，光是血影就能轻易弄死自己了。
“出其不意，用枪击毙外面的人，如果星空剑能对血影造成伤害……要是谋划得当，说不定可以一起干掉！”
李皓眼神瞬间犀利明亮起来！
未知的才恐惧！
当血影和背后的势力渐渐露出端倪，他反而不害怕了，有的只有复仇的冲动。
“不过……今夜来的血影，是我之前看到的那个吗？血影到底是不是只有一个？一个在这暗中盯梢的，难道还是什么大人物不成？”
想到这，李皓又有些担忧起来，这个血影组织，到底有多少血影，多少人，多少神秘超能者？
总感觉不是一个人！
“我只是个普通人罢了……真难啊！”
叹息一声，趁着他们走了，一时半会的未必敢回来，担心遭遇巡夜人，此刻李皓得抓紧时间找找看，看能否找到张家的石刀。
与此同时。
街道尽头。
厉鬼面具下，幽蓝的目光带着一些犹豫，就这样走吗？

可是……那个李皓真要能喊来巡夜人，那就麻烦了。
一旦暴露，恐怕会引起更大的麻烦。
“算了，先离开，以防万一，那家伙未必能请来巡夜人，哪怕袁硕也不是说清就能请来的，不过先避避。”
厉鬼面具人还是选择了离开。
身后不远处，红色血影如影随形，悄无声息地跟着一起离开。
厉鬼面具人不在意李皓能否发现什么，他们要找东西，找了无数遍了，就差彻底将整个张家掀翻了，都没找到，恐怕遗失了，李皓能找到，那才是玩笑。
倒是确定了一点，一年前李皓离开古院，并非看到了什么，只是无法接受好友意外死亡罢了。
若是真看到什么，今晚李皓大概能吓尿裤子。
这一次，倒是排除了这一点，好歹也有个交代了。
content_en:
It's getting dark.
Zhang Yuan's home is not in Qiming Community, but on an old street outside the community.
When he was a child, Li Hao loved to play in the old streets.
However, with the development of Yincheng, part of the old street was demolished, and the traders left one after another. The old street gradually became deserted. Now it is sparsely populated, and few people come to the old street anymore.
Even most of the residents have moved away, making it even deadlier than Qiming Community.
On the quiet street, there are some old houses on both sides and some scattered lights, which looks a bit strange.
If time permits, Li Hao should wait slowly, drink a little sword soaking water every day, slowly strengthen himself, and then think about other things.
However, time did not allow Li Hao to do this.
Every day that passes, the danger becomes greater for Li Hao.
Although he may be more powerful, soaking in sword water only makes him more physically strong, but it is not enough for Li Hao to have the power to deal with Hong Ying now.
Li Hao came to Zhang Yuan's house for one purpose. He wanted to see if the stone knife was still there.
If the stone knife is still there, it may be good news for Li Hao.
If it cannot be found, it may have been taken away by Hong Ying and the forces behind it. This also means that Li Hao's sword may have been exposed, and someone may even be interested in his sword.
The black panther followed Li Hao silently. In the darkness, the black puppy looked extremely inconspicuous.
The sound of slight footsteps slowly echoed on the street.
Li Hao's expression remained as usual. There was an old house in front of him with a seal on the door. That was Zhang Yuan's home.
At this moment, he could already see it.
No one was seen, and the panther gave no warning.
However, Li Hao will not place all his hopes on Black Panther.
When he was less than a hundred meters away from the gate of Zhang Yuan's house, Li Hao took out his communicator and dialed a number.
In the darkness, the communicator emitted a faint light, illuminating Li Hao's face.
"Dududu..."
After a moment, an energetic voice sounded from the opposite side: "It's late at night, have you figured out that you can't survive in the Inspection Department and want to come back?"
Loud voice!
Through the loudspeaker of the communicator, it spread on the dark streets.
Li Hao, who was still a little scared at first, suddenly felt a lot more at ease now. His voice was respectful and he said softly, "Teacher, I haven't had that idea yet."
"Then you're going to bullshit the communication!"
A somewhat annoyed voice came from the other side of the communication.
"Teacher, I have been investigating the case of Zhang Yuan's self-immolation this year, and I have found out something different. Zhang Yuan...may not have died accidentally!"
"Huh?"
In the darkness, Li Hao's face was calm, but there was a hint of ferocity in it. "I checked and found that Zhang Yuan was not the only one who self-immolated in Yincheng over the years, but several people. Although they don't seem to be related, they are vaguely related. I haven't found any specific clues yet."
Over there, it suddenly became quiet.
Li Hao had already walked to the door of Zhang Yuan's old house. He looked at the somewhat broken seal and said softly: "I am in Zhang Yuan's hometown now. I want to check if there are any other clues that prove that Zhang Yuan was murdered and not an accident."
"Li Hao!"
Over the communication line, the old man's heavy voice came: "I also know about Zhang Yuan's matter. According to you, if it is murder, then don't go there rashly, be careful of an accident!"
After that, he shouted loudly: "Wait over there for a moment. I'll say hello to the Inspection Department and Guyuan. If you need help, someone will be here soon!"
At this moment, Yuan Shuo opposite him seemed to understand something.
Li Hao doesn't need to say more.
When Li Hao called this message and told him that the discovery of Zhang Yuan was not an accident, but that he might have died of murder, and that he was at Zhang Yuan's old house, Yuan Shuo instantly understood what Li Hao meant.
It may be dangerous!
Li Hao, at this moment, he needs some power that is enough to shock him, to scare some secret agents.possible crises.
There is no need for Yuan Shuo to do anything or say anything.
It is enough to let Yuan Shuo know that he, Li Hao, is here now and is pursuing Zhang Yuan's case.
As long as he is paying attention to a big shot of Yincheng Ancient Courtyard, that is enough.
No one dared to move easily.
Otherwise, the death of Li Hao may arouse the anger of the old man in the ancient courtyard and lead to more troublesome things happening.
It is rumored that Li Hao and Yuan Shuo had a falling out before.
It turns out, not really.
On this night, Yuan Shuo's voice echoed very far in the empty streets. If anyone really paid attention to this place, they would definitely be able to hear Yuan Shuo's words.
Someone from the Ancient Courtyard and the Inspection Department may come.
At the moment when Li Hao was talking on the phone, Black Panther, who had been silent all this time, suddenly bit Li Hao's trouser leg.
Li Hao didn't find anything unusual.
However, the Black Panther was more perceptive than him after all. He might have sensed something, or Yuan Shuo's words exposed some people and attracted the Black Panther's attention.
Someone is really watching over here.
Li Hao's heart moved slightly. This was not a bad thing, but a good thing. Someone was watching. The stone knife representing Zhang Yuan's family might not have been taken away.
In the communication, Yuan Shuo continued to talk.
Li Hao quickly smiled and said: "Teacher, it's not that serious. I'm calling you just to briefly talk about this matter. The key is not this, but that I have taken over the protection task of the ancient courtyard for inspection. In a few days, I may protect the teacher and go out for inspection together."
"You?"
Yuan Shuo over there seemed to be a little surprised, and he quickly laughed heartily and said: "Okay, then I'll wait for you! It just so happens that the inspection task this time is a bit complicated. You have been with me for two years and have learned a lot, but you have never practiced it! Li Hao, how about this being your practical class? If you perform well, I can consider giving you the status of a non-staff student. Although there are many rules in the ancient academy, as long as you make merit during this inspection, I can still graduate you!"
"You have to know that if you can get a diploma, even if you still stay in the Inspection Division, a diploma can get you promoted to two levels! Becoming a first-level patrol inspector is a sure thing, and you have a much better future than you have now!"
Li Hao smiled and said, "Teacher, let's talk about it after we meet later. I'll take a look inside first to see if there are any clues. Once Zhang Yuan's case is investigated and the murderer is caught, I will find a way to return to the ancient courtyard without the teacher's advice."
"Alright!"
Yuan Shuo warned me again: "Contact me anytime if you have anything. There is no problem that cannot be solved by the Inspection Department and the Ancient Courtyard. You still have some dignity as a teacher. When the time comes, if you give me a fight in the future, I will risk my life. Even some experts can be invited to come!"
As soon as these words came out, Li Hao was suddenly shocked and silently moved.
He knew what Teacher Yuan meant.
When the time comes, his so-called expert may be the night watchman.
In the past, Li Hao never said much to the teacher.
He was worried about spreading the trouble to teachers.
However, with the teacher's wisdom, when he heard Li Hao say that Zhang Yuan's self-immolation might not be an accident, he would immediately think that it might be interference from superpowers.
Only then did he say what he wanted to do to find an expert.
However, even if Mr. Yuan's status is high, the night watchman is not just invited. Li Hao's matter is not a business matter, but a private matter, which may require a high price.
"I know, thank you teacher!"
Li Hao hung up the communication and tore up the seal.
When Li Hao took Black Panther into the ancient house.
Outside the quiet street, there was silence for a long time.
In the darkness, a pair of eyes with a faint blue light were looming.
Under the night, a black figure seemed to be a part of the night. It was black from top to bottom, except for the pair of faint blue eyes, which were a little penetrating. There was a ghost-like mask on the face, which concealed the appearance. It was unknown whether he was a man or a woman.
"Li Hao, Zhang Yuan’s classmate, best friend, and second-level student of Yincheng Ancient Academy. After Zhang Yuan’s death last year, he dropped out and joined the Inspection Department, and has been pursuing Zhang Yuan’s self-immolation incident. Today, I reported to Wang Jie, the head of the inspection driver's office, that six cases of self-immolation were connected in series and were intended to be consolidated. "
Information about Li Hao flashed in Heiying's mind instantly.
Li Hao dropped out of school last year and joined the Inspection Department, and has actually become an informant.
What's more, it seems that it's more than that. Li Hao may still be a key figure, but this matter is not within the jurisdiction of the black shadow. I don't know for the time being. It's just that someone warned Li Hao not to make any moves lightly and stay there for use.
Heiying thought in his heart that he really shouldn't move lightly.
Was Li Hao talking to his teacher Yuan Shuo just now?
Yuan Shuo, the top elder of Yincheng Ancient Academy and the director of the Department of Ancient Civilization Exploration, cooperates with the night watchman. He is one of the few big-shot figures in the entire Yincheng who can directly talk to the night watchman.
"No one needs to tell me, Li Hao can't move..."
The black shadow quietly approached the Zhang family's ancient house. He wanted to know why Li Hao went in?
Zhang Yuan set himself on fire and died in the ancient courtyard. What clues can there be at home?
Or is it to find something?
As for what he is looking for, Heiying doesn't know, but his mission is to keep an eye on everyone who enters or even approaches the Zhang family's old house.
“Woo! "
A low chirping sound came from the black panther's throat. It bit Li Hao's trousers, feeling a little anxious.
It seems to be telling something.
Li Hao remained calm, but he was wary in his heart.
Is anyone approaching?
Isn't the phone call between myself and the teacher enough to dispel some people's thoughts?
Without saying much, Li Hao gently touched Black Panther's head and comforted him for a while, then looked at the abandoned Zhang family's old house.
This is a small courtyard.
Directly ahead is the main house.
On both sides, one is Zhang Yuan's second bedroom and the other is the kitchen. This place is very familiar to Li Hao. He often came here when he was a child. Even when he grew up, before Li Hao's parents passed away, his home was not big and not suitable for playing. Li Hao would come here often.
This time, Li Hao's main target was the Zhang family's stone knife.
He glanced at it. It seemed that no one had entered this ancient house, but someone must have been there. Not to mention other things, the placement of some things did not look unusual, but to Li Hao, it was clear that they had been touched.
Apart from Zhang Yuan, Li Hao is probably the most familiar with the Zhang Yuan family.
In the courtyard, even the old tree had been tampered with. It might have been dug up by the roots and then replanted.
"If Shi Dao is still in the Zhang family, he must not be in the main room or the second bedroom, 100%! "
Li Hao came here often, so he naturally knew the situation. If he had been in these two places, he would have seen it long ago, and he would have remembered that he often rummaged through the Zhang family. At that time, he regarded this as his own home and never left the house.
"The last time I saw a stone knife was when Uncle Zhang hit Xiaoyuan. I remember that Uncle Zhang casually threw it to the ground, but I don't know if he picked it up later. "
Li Hao thought about the past, and he vaguely remembered that Zhang Yuan seemed to have dug out the stone knife from nowhere at that time.
Zhang Yuan's father probably didn't remember where he had thrown it, but his child dug it out, so he took the opportunity to beat Zhang Yuan. As for any ancestral items, Zhang Yuan's father probably didn't take them seriously.
Just a piece of broken stone!
What heirloom?
Even if it is, it's not worth much. Why do you want that thing? If Zhang Yuan doesn't dig it out, Zhang's father may never remember that there is still a stone in the family that has been passed down.
Following the unclear direction in his memory, Li Hao walked slowly towards the corner of the yard.
There are some stones piled up there, which were originally used to mend the wall.
Li Hao quickly observed that there was no such stone in his memory.
He remembered that the stone was somewhat similar to the knife.
“There’s someone secretly watching me, but it’s not easy to look for him in a big way. "
Just as he was thinking about it, the black panther, who had been silent all this time, suddenly neighed in a low voice."Woo!"
It was not a sound of protecting food, but with some fear, the black panther made a whimpering sound.
At this time, Li Hao's scalp suddenly felt numb!
He followed the panther's line of sight and looked towards the main house, his heart skipped a beat. At this moment, his heart beat even more violently.
The door to the main house was originally closed and there was nothing there.
But at this time, the door seemed to have opened a gap, and in that gap, a faint hint of red could be seen.
"Blood Shadow?"
Li Hao's heart beat violently, and the blood shadow came out?
He vaguely seemed to have seen it before, but according to his inference, the blood shadow should be out on a rainy night. Why did it appear now, and it was in the Zhang family!
"Could it be that...this blood shadow has been staying in the Zhang family, looking for the stone knife, and has not left?"
A wisp of cold sweat seeped out from Li Hao's head.
The encounter came too early!
Li Hao was not fully prepared yet. He was encountering a bloody shadow here. Once the other party attacked him and burned him, Li Hao would have almost no room to resist.
"Why are you here?"
"Damn it, it appeared too early, I didn't even see the night watchman..."
Li Hao's body was slightly stiff. At this moment, his body was trembling slightly, and he even wanted to turn around and run away.
But outside, someone might be staring at him.
Yes, most people cannot see the blood shadow.
You can't escape!
Otherwise, even if he escapes, something will be exposed, such as the fact that he can see blood shadows, which is also a huge trouble.
Since you can't see it, there is no reason to be afraid.
Countless thoughts flashed through, and the next moment, Li Hao scolded: "What's your name? Be quiet!"
After scolding the Black Panther, Li Hao looked at the main room and shouted: "Is there someone inside? I am an inspector from the Inspection Department, who is inside?"
Li Hao raised the Whirlpool III, pointed it at the main room, and shouted again: "Is there anyone? Come out!"
He clearly saw the corner of the blood shadow, but he resisted not looking at the red corner. Instead, he kept staring at the door and yelling in the direction of the door.
Li Hao approached the main door step by step.
Suddenly, with a lunge and a kick, with a bang, the door of the main house was kicked open by Li Hao.
A loud bang also attracted the attention of a few nearby households.
Vaguely, there was a sound of rustling.
Li Hao ignored this, kicked open the door, looked at the dark main room again, and shouted: "Is there anyone there? I am an inspector from the Inspection Department. If you don't come out, I will shoot!"
At this moment, Li Hao was staring ahead, but sweat was seeping out of his forehead, and his arms were shaking slightly.
At his feet, the black panther had long been lying motionless, so frightened.
In Li Hao's peripheral vision and in the eyes of the black panther, at this moment, a red blood shadow was actually standing on Li Hao's left side. The blood shadow was almost touching Li Hao's cheek.
However, Li Hao seemed not to see it and had no reaction at all.
His eyes kept falling on the main room.
"No one?"
Li Hao's voice was trembling, and he cursed in a low voice: "Damn! Fortunately, no other colleagues were here, otherwise they would have laughed to death. It scared me so late at night, I thought the murderer was hiding here!"
Li Hao let out a long breath, as if he didn't see the blood shadow.
Wiping the sweat from his forehead, he looked down at the black panther and struck with his hand: "Silly dog, why are you barking when it's okay? You're scaring me to death!"
The black panther was beaten, a little innocent, a little scared.
Didn't you see?
This dog saw it!
It doesn't dare to raise its head now.
Because the blood shadow was floating on its head.
Li Hao seemed to know nothing. He had just slapped the black panther and even passed through the blood shadow with his arm, but he felt nothing at all. Only a trace of invisible coldness penetrated into his arm.
But he didn't feel any blockage from penetrating anything.
"noneForm exists! "
Li Hao was actually bold enough to test the blood shadow. He wanted to see if it was really invisible and intangible. He hit the black panther just to touch the blood shadow naturally.
As a result... I really can't hit it!
“Damn, we’re in big trouble, this means the firearms are useless at all! "
Li Hao was frightened in his heart, but relied on his strong concentration to prevent himself from showing anything strange.
In the eyes of outsiders, he should not be able to see the shadow of blood.
So there was no problem with the tapping just now.
Li Hao cursed Black Panther and cursed in a low voice: "Damn stupid dog, if you keep yelling at me, I will chop you into pieces! I kicked down the door of Xiaoyuan's house. I was so scared that I wanted to call the teacher and ask him to go find someone from the Inspection Department and Guyuan! "
Li Hao seemed to be upset and kicked him again!
This time, it still penetrated the blood shadow without touching it.
Li Hao's courage is not bad.
This blood shadow did not attack him upon meeting him, but seemed to have been observing something. In this case, he had to pretend that he could not see it at this moment, so what should he do.
Looking at the dark old house again, Li Hao breathed out: "It's quite late at night, but it's quite intrusive. No, why don't we call the teacher... The guys in the inspection department feel unreliable and useless. They closed Xiaoyuan's case, and they didn't find anything unusual... If it doesn't work, just ask the teacher to find those men in black to come forward." "
Li Hao had seen the man in black, the night watchman, once from a distance, but of course, he had no contact with him.
Talking to myself now is just to intimidate.
If the blood shadow is conscious, then it should understand who the man in black is talking about, the night watchman!
Li Hao also wanted to test whether the night watchman and the blood shadow were in the same group.
At this critical moment, Li Hao calmed down.
Not only did he not escape, he was still trying to find something.
Escape is the stupidest choice. Once he escapes, the fact that he can see the blood shadow will be exposed immediately, and he will have to die.
According to Li Hao's analysis, even if he was killed by Blood Shadow, it would have been on a rainy night, not now. There must be some reasons for this. In this case, it's better to win once!
Li Hao was still talking to himself, as if hesitating: "Those men in black look scary too. The teacher went to look for them, but I don't know if they can be found... No matter, the inspection department has no clues at all, so maybe we have to rely on them. I am timid and incompetent, and there is nothing I can do. I was scared half to death when I came to take a look at it at night. I'm afraid I can't continue the investigation." "
Li Hao looked a little frustrated, took out the communicator and gritted his teeth: "I can only ask the teacher for help! "
The next moment, Li Hao started dialing Yuan Shuo's number.
At this moment, Li Hao was slightly shocked. The blood shadow around him suddenly began to vibrate. Outside the courtyard wall, a faint red thread spread out and connected to the blood shadow.
The blood shadow seemed to have received some instructions. The next moment, the blood shadow quickly floated away and disappeared into the yard.
Not only that, after a while, the black panther climbed up and shook its tail, seeming to become active.
The dog looked at Li Hao with some relief.
“Woof woof! "
It seems to be saying, it's okay, the person is gone, and the ghost shadow is gone.
Li Hao's face was a little solemn.
Xueying and the people outside the yard seemed to be in a group. This was not important. He had already guessed that Xueying did not exist alone, but was organized.
The key is that people outside the yard seem to be able to see the blood shadow, and can even contact and control the blood shadow to make the blood shadow leave.
Li Hao said he wanted to find his teacher and the night watchman, which probably made people outside a little worried, so he chose to leave.
The intimidation tactics worked!
But Li Hao was not happy at all. The spreading red thread was a bit like the starlight he saw when he drank water before, that is, the divine starlight.Secret power.
"The person outside is a super mysterious person!"
"The other party has a cooperative or controlling relationship with Xueying. Is the other party letting Xueying test him?"
"I can't kill the blood shadow with a gun...then...what if there's a person outside? If I kill that person by surprise, what will happen to the blood shadow?"
At this moment, Li Hao suddenly felt that he had grasped something key.
The blood shadow is terrifying, but as long as it is a human being...even a superpower, as long as it is a human being, it is impossible to be invulnerable.
"Blood shadow... mysterious man..."
Li Hao murmured in his heart. Not only that, the moment he just touched the blood shadow, the silent jade sword seemed to be about to move. Li Hao was guessing, could the Starry Sky Sword hurt the blood shadow?
"This time, even if I can't find the stone knife, I didn't come here in vain!"
Li Hao suddenly became a little excited. Maybe, I can deal with these guys, provided that these guys don't care about me, otherwise, they can easily kill themselves with just the blood shadow.
"Suddenly, kill the people outside with guns. If the Starry Sky Sword can cause damage to the blood shadow... If the plan is right, maybe we can kill them together!"
Li Hao's eyes instantly became sharp and bright!
Fear the unknown!
When the blood shadow and the forces behind it gradually emerged, he was no longer afraid, and only had the urge for revenge.
"But... the blood shadow that came tonight is the one I saw before? Is there only one blood shadow? Is the one who is secretly watching here some big shot?"
Thinking of this, Li Hao became a little worried again. How many blood shadows, how many people, and how many mysterious superpowers are there in this blood shadow organization?
I always feel like I’m not alone!
"I'm just an ordinary person...it's so difficult!"
Sighing, while they were gone, they might not dare to come back for a while, for fear of encountering the night watchman. At this moment, Li Hao had to seize the time to search to see if he could find the Zhang family's stone knife.
at the same time.
End of street.
Under the mask of the ghost, the blue eyes showed some hesitation. Are you going to leave like this?
But... if that Li Hao could really call the night watchman, it would be troublesome.
Once exposed, it may cause even greater trouble.
"Forget it, let's leave first, just in case. That guy may not be able to invite the night watchman. Even Yuan Shuo can't invite him with clear explanation, but we should avoid it first."
The ghost masked man still chose to leave.
Not far behind him, the red blood shadow followed him like a shadow, quietly following him away.
The Li Gui Mask Man didn't care whether Li Hao could find anything. They were looking for something. They had searched countless times and almost completely overturned the entire Zhang family. They couldn't find it. I'm afraid it was lost. If Li Hao could find it, it would be a joke.
But one thing is certain. When Li Hao left the ancient courtyard a year ago, it was not because he saw something, but because he could not accept the accidental death of his friend.
If he really saw something, Li Hao would probably wet his pants tonight.
This time, this was ruled out, and at least there was an explanation.
